# Nexus 9000v, NX-OS 9.3(12), second switch of the vPC pair (vPC roles removed, memberless trunk port-channel201),
# targeted "show running-config interface port-channel201" after each configuration step, 2026-11-22.
# step: before (spanning-tree port type network)
interface port-channel201
  switchport mode trunk
  switchport trunk allowed vlan 428
  spanning-tree port type network
# step: vpc peer-link
interface port-channel201
  switchport mode trunk
  switchport trunk allowed vlan 428
  spanning-tree port type network
  vpc peer-link
# step: no vpc peer-link
interface port-channel201
  switchport mode trunk
  switchport trunk allowed vlan 428
# step: vpc peer-link (without a spanning-tree port type line before; NX-OS answers "Warning: Bridge Assurance MUST be enabled at the remotely connected interface")
interface port-channel201
  switchport mode trunk
  switchport trunk allowed vlan 428
  spanning-tree port type network
  vpc peer-link
# step: spanning-tree port type edge trunk, vpc peer-link
interface port-channel201
  switchport mode trunk
  switchport trunk allowed vlan 428
  spanning-tree port type network
  vpc peer-link
# step: no vpc peer-link, spanning-tree port type network
interface port-channel201
  switchport mode trunk
  switchport trunk allowed vlan 428
  spanning-tree port type network
